title: Pair depth of a list with a leading pair
statement: Let $p$ be a pair of Boolean circuits and let $ps$ be a list of such pairs. The pair depth of the list beginning with $p$ is the maximum of the depths of the two circuits in $p$ and the pair depth of $ps$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a pair of Boolean circuits on $n$ inputs
$ps$ is a list of pairs of Boolean circuits on $n$ inputs
